name: image-render-server
description: Multi-engine image rendering server supporting Leafer, Fabric.js, Konva, and Playwright

scripts.build: pnpm install && tsc -b packages/core packages/server packages/leafer-engine packages/fabric5-engine packages/fabric-engine packages/playwright-engine packages/konva-engine
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist node_modules packages/*/node_modules && find . -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.js.map' -o -name '*.d.ts' -o -name '*.d.ts.map' \) -not -name 'eslint.config.js' -delete && find packages -type f \( -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.js.map' -o -name '*.d.ts' -o -name '*.d.ts.map' \) -not -path '*/pages/*' -delete && echo 'Cleaned'
scripts.start:leafer: pnpm run build && LOG_PRETTY=true node packages/leafer-engine/dist/server.js
scripts.start:konva: pnpm run build && LOG_PRETTY=true node packages/konva-engine/dist/server.js
scripts.start:fabric: pnpm run build && LOG_PRETTY=true node packages/fabric-engine/dist/server.js
scripts.start:fabric5: pnpm run build && LOG_PRETTY=true node packages/fabric5-engine/dist/server.js
scripts.start:playwright: pnpm run build && LOG_PRETTY=true node packages/playwright-engine/dist/server.js
